hero.headline: Individual Therapy
hero.subhead: Private sessions with board-certified counselors to process personal history, set goals, and develop individualized relapse prevention strategies.

image.alt: A private one-to-one counseling room at Des Moines Wellness Center

sections.heading: What Individual Therapy involves
body: Individual therapy is the part of treatment that belongs only to you. You meet one-to-one with the same licensed clinician throughout your stay, which means you are not re-explaining your history to a new face every week.

Sessions are where the details of your own situation get worked through — what led to substance use, what has been tried before, what is waiting for you at home, and what specifically tends to precede a return to use. That work produces your relapse-prevention plan, and it is revisited as your circumstances change rather than written once at intake.

items.title: A consistent clinician
items.text: You work with the same counselor across levels of care, so progress carries forward instead of restarting.

items.title: Your own treatment plan
items.text: Goals, triggers and coping strategies are written for your history, not a template, and adjusted as you progress.

items.title: Private by design
items.text: Individual sessions are confidential and separate from group work — the place for anything you are not ready to say in a room.

sections.heading: Where it fits in your care
sections.subheading: Available at these levels of care. Most people move through more than one.

items.title: Medical Detox
items.text: Brief supportive contact while you stabilize medically.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Regular one-to-one sessions as the core of the weekly schedule.

items.title: Intensive Outpatient (IOP)
items.text: Ongoing sessions while you return to work, study or family life.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis
items.text: Coordinated with psychiatric care when a co-occurring condition is being treated.

sections.heading: Speak with our clinical team
body: Our intake specialists are available 24/7 for a confidential assessment. We can talk through which therapies fit your situation and verify your insurance on the same call.
